mapper.select: SELECT id, waybill_id, dealer_id, etd_to_dealer, eta_to_dealer, received_date, delivery_status, remark7, row_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at FROM t_waybill_dealer WHERE waybill_id = #{waybillId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT wd.id, wd.waybill_id, wd.dealer_id, wd.etd_to_dealer, wd.eta_to_dealer, wd.received_date, wd.delivery_status, wd.remark7, wd.row_status, wd.confirmed_by, wd.confirmed_at FROM t_waybill_dealer wd INNER JOIN t_waybill w ON w.id = wd.waybill_id WHERE w.dispatch_list_id = #{dispatchListId} ORDER BY wd.id ASC
